name: E2E Portal Test

on:
  push:
    branches: [main, develop]
    paths:
      - 'crates/**'
      - 'portal/**'
      - '.github/workflows/e2e-portal-test.yml'
  pull_request:
    branches: [main, develop]
    paths:
      - 'crates/**'
      - 'portal/**'
      - '.github/workflows/e2e-portal-test.yml'
  workflow_dispatch:

env:
  CARGO_TERM_COLOR: always
  RUST_BACKTRACE: 1

jobs:
  build-and-test:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    steps:
      - name: Checkout repository
        uses: actions/checkout@v4

      - name: Install Rust toolchain
        uses: dtolnay/rust-toolchain@stable
        with:
          components: clippy, rustfmt

      - name: Cache Cargo registry
        uses: actions/cache@v4
        with:
          path: |
            ~/.cargo/registry
            ~/.cargo/git
            target
          key: ${{ runner.os }}-cargo-${{ hashFiles('**/Cargo.lock') }}
          restore-keys: |
            ${{ runner.os }}-cargo-

      - name: Build imix_connect with SOCKS5 UDP support
        run: |
          cargo build --release -p imix_connect
          # Verify binary exists
          ls -lh target/release/imix_connect

      - name: Setup Node.js and pnpm
        uses: kubb-labs/config/.github/setup@main
        with:
          node-version: 22
          cache: true

      - name: Install Portal dependencies
        working-directory: ./portal
        run: pnpm install --frozen-lockfile

      - name: Install Playwright Browsers
        working-directory: ./portal
        run: npx playwright install --with-deps chromium

      - name: Run E2E Portal Tests
        working-directory: ./portal
        run: |
          # Start the local test server or mock services if required
          # Assuming the test suite handles its own server startup or uses a mock
          npx playwright test --project=portal-e2e --reporter=list,json

      - name: Upload Test Results
        if: always()
        uses: actions/upload-artifact@v4
        with:
          name: playwright-report
          path: portal/playwright-report/
          retention-days: 30

      - name: Upload Traffic Verification Logs
        if: always()
        uses: actions/upload-artifact@v4
        with:
          name: traffic-logs
          path: portal/test-results/
          retention-days: 14

  verify-socks5-udp:
    needs: build-and-test
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    steps:
      - name: Checkout repository
        uses: actions/checkout@v4

      - name: Install Rust toolchain
        uses: dtolnay/rust-toolchain@stable

      - name: Cache Cargo registry
        uses: actions/cache@v4
        with:
          path: |
            ~/.cargo/registry
            ~/.cargo/git
            target
          key: ${{ runner.os }}-cargo-${{ hashFiles('**/Cargo.lock') }}
          restore-keys: |
            ${{ runner.os }}-cargo-

      - name: Build imix_connect
        run: cargo build --release -p imix_connect

      - name: Run SOCKS5 UDP Integration Test
        run: |
          # Start imix_connect in background with UDP support enabled
          ./target/release/imix_connect --config tests/fixtures/socks5_udp_config.json &
          IMIX_PID=$!
          
          # Wait for service to be ready
          sleep 5
          
          # Run UDP specific test script
          ./tests/scripts/verify_socks5_udp.sh
          
          # Cleanup
          kill $IMIX_PID || true
